notes.title: Enemy AI patch
notes.content: Updated the Enemy AI so when the player gets knocked down, the player is not ganged up on as easily.

notes.title: Gameplay Updates
notes.content:
* Updated the Enemy AI to be more balanced in combat when knocked down
* Optimized the Grasslands level with grass
* Added a cheat code 

For the Demo
* The demo plays through the entire Graveyard stage.

BONUS - here's a cheat code:

Restore Energy and Lives to full for each player

Key Combo when you pause the game- JJJBBBJJJ

J=Jump
B=Block

You should hear a beep when you do it right. Have fun!

notes.title: Added a "Disable Mid Game Story" and other updates
notes.content:
Added a "Disable Mid Game Story" option during gameplay if you are one of the players who want to have less story and more action during the gameplay (the BOSS storyline is still intact).

Fixed the timing issue when the game is unpaused - it's back to being fast paced!

Added 5:4 support for those playing the game on old school monitors. 

Enjoy!
